subject: tech
alt: learner comparing corrosion prevention methods including galvanising and electroplating on metal samples
prompt: Create a clear, single-subject, flat friendly educational illustration for Grade 9 learners showing a learner comparing metal samples with different surface treatments (galvanised, electroplated, corroded). Include visual indicators for corrosion processes, protective coatings, food preservation methods (frozen, canned, dried items), and plastic recycling symbols. Use simple bright shapes, a clean white background, and no text, words, numbers, or labels in the image.
